South Korea ​relies heavily ⁠on oil imports and sourced 70% of its supplies from the Middle East in 2025, most of it delivered through the Strait of Hormuz , according to the Industry Ministry.

newsDocuments.headline: India bonds set to rally along Treasuries as Democratic win drives oil to two-month low

segments.text: MUMBAI: Indian government bonds are set to advance on Thursday, tracking a sharp US Treasury rally after Democrats captured both chambers of Congress, raising hopes of an end to the Iran war, whichdrove crude oil prices to a two-month low.
The dollar declined 0.2% , which may help the Indian rupee. Brent crude plunged 8% on Wednesday to its lowest in more than two months, extending losses in Asian trade to $93.70 a barrel.
For India, the world’s third-largest oil importer, cheaper crude reduces imported inflation risks and eases pressure on government finances.

newsDocuments.headline: Oil falls for a fourth day on expectations for lower risk of Iran war escalation

segments.text: SINGAPORE: Oil prices fell for a fourth day on Thursday on expectations the losses US President Donald Trump’s Republican Party suffered in Congressional elections this week may reduce the risk of further escalation of the US-Israeli war on
Brent futures fell 80 cents, or 0.85% to $93.82 a barrel as of 0426 GMT, while US West Texas Intermediate crude futures were down $1.2, or 1.36%, to $86.92.
A resolution to the conflict could restore oil flows from the Middle East impacted by the war, though analysts caution the way forward remains uncertain.
